title: Chau Doc river and mountain day
summary: Breakfast at Chợ Châu Đốc, a boat among the fish rafts, the halls at Núi Sam, and the riverbank when the heat drops. Trà Sư is the other half day.

stops.name: Chau Doc Market
stops.note: Bún cá at the edge of the hall. A closing hour was not printed.

approach.note: From a river room in phường Châu Đốc. Minutes are check on arrival.

stops.name: Fish-raft village
stops.note: A boat among the raft houses. The fare is check on arrival. Châu Phong is the other bank if you want the mosques instead of a second loop.

approach.note: From the town bank. No posted minute count.

stops.name: Ba Chua Xu Temple
stops.note: The hall at the foot of Núi Sam. Come before midday outside festival season.

approach.note: The road is printed as both about 5 km and about 7 km. Minutes are check on arrival.

stops.name: Tay An Pagoda
stops.note: The same foot-of-the-hill walk. The tomb is beside it if you have time.

approach.note: From the shrine. A published walking minute was not found.

stops.name: Hau riverfront
stops.note: The bank after the heat drops. There is no bar street.

approach.note: Back from Núi Sam. Minutes are check on arrival.

seoTitle: Chau Doc in a day — market, rafts, Sam Mountain
seoDescription: A Châu Đốc day: bún cá at the market, a boat among the fish rafts, the temples at Núi Sam, and the Hậu bank at dusk.
